question: Has the larger 78M architecture been tested with the optimizer that won the corrected full-sequence comparison?
answer: No AdamW78 arm exists in the matched-curve-v1 three-arm experiment. Its size comparison isolates width within Muon, but not within the winning AdamW recipe.
scope: This is an audit of the saved controlled comparison and the width704 checkpoints, not a claim that every earlier experiment is comparable.
inference: The completed 42M full pass validates data coverage and improves the public score; it does not rule out AdamW78 or establish the optimal model size.
next_hypothesis: At the same bounded training-time checkpoints and with AdamW held fixed, increasing width512/FF1536/heads8 to width704/FF2112/heads11 may improve the held-out learning curve.
controls: Same fresh exclusion index and original tokenizer/targets
Same AdamW learning rate and full-pass schedule
Same logical batch, full-sequence budgets, greedy evaluation and runtime versions
Report both actual rows processed and total GPU time; do not infer a size effect by comparing different optimizers
decision_gate: First finish the active CPU averaging screen. Any new size run requires CPU preparation, Drive verification and a fixed short time budget; promote only after both held-out subsets improve without added total execution failures, followed by a second-seed check.
